statements.query: MATCH (cluster:RDSCluster)<-[:RESOURCE]-(:AWSAccount{id: $AWS_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:AWSOrganization{id: $ORGANIZATION_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID}) WHERE cluster.exposed_internet IS NOT NULL WITH cluster LIMIT $LIMIT_SIZE REMOVE cluster.exposed_internet, cluster.exposed_internet_type, cluster.publicContext return COUNT(*) as TotalCompleted

MATCH (n)<-[:RESOURCE]-(:AWSAccount{id: $AWS_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:AWSOrganization{id: $ORGANIZATION_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID}) where n.exposed_internet IS NOT NULL AND (n:RDSInstance OR n:RDSSnapshot) WITH n LIMIT $LIMIT_SIZE REMOVE n.exposed_internet, n.exposed_internet_type, n.publicContext return COUNT(*) as TotalCompleted

MATCH (rds:RDSInstance{publicly_accessible: true})<-[:RESOURCE]-(:AWSAccount{id: $AWS_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:AWSOrganization{id: $ORGANIZATION_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID}) SET rds.exposed_internet = true,(CASE WHEN NOT 'direct' IN coalesce(rds.exposed_internet_type , []) THEN rds END).exposed_internet_type = coalesce(rds.exposed_internet_type , []) + 'direct';

MATCH (cidr:IpRange{range:'0.0.0.0/0'})-[:MEMBER_OF_IP_RULE]->(:IpPermissionInbound)-[:MEMBER_OF_EC2_SECURITY_GROUP]->(:EC2SecurityGroup)<-[:MEMBER_OF_EC2_SECURITY_GROUP]-(rds:RDSInstance{publicly_accessible: true})<-[:RESOURCE]-(:AWSAccount{id: $AWS_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:AWSOrganization{id: $ORGANIZATION_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID}) SET rds.exposed_internet = true,(CASE WHEN NOT 'direct_ipv4' IN coalesce(rds.exposed_internet_type , []) THEN rds END).exposed_internet_type = coalesce(rds.exposed_internet_type , []) + 'direct_ipv4';

MATCH (cidr:Ipv6Range{range:'::/0'})-[:MEMBER_OF_IP_RULE]->(:IpPermissionInbound)-[:MEMBER_OF_EC2_SECURITY_GROUP]->(:EC2SecurityGroup)<-[:MEMBER_OF_EC2_SECURITY_GROUP]-(rds:RDSInstance{publicly_accessible: true})<-[:RESOURCE]-(:AWSAccount{id: $AWS_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:AWSOrganization{id: $ORGANIZATION_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID}) SET rds.exposed_internet = true,(CASE WHEN NOT 'direct_ipv6' IN coalesce(rds.exposed_internet_type , []) THEN rds END).exposed_internet_type = coalesce(rds.exposed_internet_type , []) + 'direct_ipv6';

MATCH (route:EC2Route{destination_cidr_block: '0.0.0.0/0'})<-[:MEMBER_OF_ROUTE_TABLE]-(:EC2RouteTable)-[:HAS_ASSOCIATION]->(:EC2RouteTableAssociation)<-[:HAS_EXPLICIT_ASSOCIATION|HAS_IMPLICIT_ASSOCIATION]-(:EC2Subnet)<-[:CONNECTED_TO]-(:DBSubnetGroup)<-[:MEMBER_OF_DB_SUBNET_GROUP]-(rds:RDSInstance{publicly_accessible: true})<-[:RESOURCE]-(:AWSAccount{id: $AWS_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:AWSOrganization{id: $ORGANIZATION_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID}) WHERE route.gateway_id STARTS WITH 'igw-' SET rds.exposed_internet = true,(CASE WHEN NOT 'public_subnet_ipv4' IN coalesce(rds.exposed_internet_type , []) THEN rds END).exposed_internet_type = coalesce(rds.exposed_internet_type , []) + 'public_subnet_ipv4';

MATCH (route:EC2Route{destination_ipv6_cidr_block: '::/0'})<-[:MEMBER_OF_ROUTE_TABLE]-(:EC2RouteTable)-[:HAS_ASSOCIATION]->(:EC2RouteTableAssociation)<-[:HAS_EXPLICIT_ASSOCIATION|HAS_IMPLICIT_ASSOCIATION]-(:EC2Subnet)<-[:CONNECTED_TO]-(:DBSubnetGroup)<-[:MEMBER_OF_DB_SUBNET_GROUP]-(rds:RDSInstance{publicly_accessible: true})<-[:RESOURCE]-(:AWSAccount{id: $AWS_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:AWSOrganization{id: $ORGANIZATION_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID}) WHERE route.gateway_id STARTS WITH 'igw-' SET rds.exposed_internet = true,(CASE WHEN NOT 'public_subnet_ipv6' IN coalesce(rds.exposed_internet_type , []) THEN rds END).exposed_internet_type = coalesce(rds.exposed_internet_type , []) + 'public_subnet_ipv6';

statements.__comment: Clears snapshot flags left by an earlier sync; a snapshot unshared since must not stay public.
statements.query: MATCH (snapshot:RDSSnapshot)<-[:RESOURCE]-(:AWSAccount{id: $AWS_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:AWSOrganization{id: $ORGANIZATION_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID}) WHERE snapshot.exposed_internet IS NOT NULL WITH snapshot LIMIT $LIMIT_SIZE REMOVE snapshot.exposed_internet, snapshot.exposed_internet_type, snapshot.publicContext return COUNT(*) as TotalCompleted

statements.__comment: A snapshot whose restore attribute holds 'all' can be copied or restored by any AWS account, whatever its source instance is (which may be private or deleted).
statements.query: MATCH (snapshot:RDSSnapshot)<-[:RESOURCE]-(:AWSAccount{id: $AWS_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:AWSOrganization{id: $ORGANIZATION_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID}) WHERE 'all' IN snapshot.restore_attribute_values SET snapshot.exposed_internet = true,(CASE WHEN NOT 'restore_all_attrib' IN coalesce(snapshot.exposed_internet_type , []) THEN snapshot END).exposed_internet_type = coalesce(snapshot.exposed_internet_type , []) + 'restore_all_attrib';

MATCH (rds:RDSInstance)<-[:RESOURCE]-(:AWSAccount{id: $AWS_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:AWSOrganization{id: $ORGANIZATION_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID}) WHERE rds.exposed_internet = true WITH rds OPTIONAL MATCH (cidr)-[:MEMBER_OF_IP_RULE]->(rule:IpPermissionInbound)-[:MEMBER_OF_EC2_SECURITY_GROUP]->(sg:EC2SecurityGroup)<-[:MEMBER_OF_EC2_SECURITY_GROUP]-(rds) WHERE (cidr:IpRange AND cidr.range = '0.0.0.0/0') OR (cidr:Ipv6Range AND cidr.range = '::/0') WITH rds, collect(DISTINCT {securityGroupId: sg.id, port: toString(rule.fromport), protocol: rule.protocol, ipRanges: CASE WHEN cidr:IpRange THEN [cidr.range] WHEN cidr:Ipv6Range THEN [cidr.range] ELSE [] END}) as securityRules SET rds.publicContext = apoc.convert.toJson([{resource: rds.id, resourceType: 'aws-database-rds-instance', context: [{instanceId: rds.id, instanceArn: rds.arn, endpoint: rds.endpoint_address, port: rds.endpoint_port, engine: rds.engine, engineVersion: rds.engine_version, publiclyAccessible: rds.publicly_accessible, exposureTypes: rds.exposed_internet_type, securityRules: securityRules, dbSubnetGroup: rds.db_subnet_group}]}])

MATCH (snapshot:RDSSnapshot)<-[:RESOURCE]-(:AWSAccount{id: $AWS_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:AWSOrganization{id: $ORGANIZATION_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID}) WHERE snapshot.exposed_internet = true WITH snapshot OPTIONAL MATCH (snapshot)<-[:IS_SNAPSHOT_SOURCE]-(rds:RDSInstance) WITH snapshot, head(collect(rds)) AS rds SET snapshot.publicContext = apoc.convert.toJson([{resource: snapshot.id, resourceType: 'aws-database-rds-snapshot', context: [{snapshotId: snapshot.id, snapshotArn: snapshot.arn, sourceInstanceId: rds.id, sourceEngine: coalesce(rds.engine, snapshot.engine), restoreAttribute: snapshot.restore_attribute_values, exposureTypes: snapshot.exposed_internet_type, encrypted: coalesce(snapshot.encrypted, false)}]}])

statements.__comment: A cluster's endpoints resolve to its member instances, so it is exposed when any member is. Runs after the instance statements; the member must sit in the same account, because ingest links members by db_cluster_identifier alone.
statements.query: MATCH (account:AWSAccount{id: $AWS_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:AWSOrganization{id: $ORGANIZATION_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID}) MATCH (account)-[:RESOURCE]->(cluster:RDSCluster)<-[:IS_CLUSTER_MEMBER_OF]-(rds:RDSInstance{exposed_internet: true})<-[:RESOURCE]-(account) WITH cluster, collect(DISTINCT {instanceId: rds.id, exposureTypes: rds.exposed_internet_type}) AS members SET cluster.exposed_internet = true, cluster.exposed_internet_type = ['public_member_instance'], cluster.publicContext = apoc.convert.toJson([{resource: cluster.id, resourceType: 'aws-database-rds-cluster', context: [{clusterId: cluster.id, clusterIdentifier: cluster.db_cluster_identifier, endpoint: cluster.endpoint, port: cluster.port, engine: cluster.engine, exposedMembers: members}]}])

statements.__comment: Clears cluster snapshot flags left by an earlier sync; a snapshot unshared since must not stay public.
statements.query: MATCH (snapshot:RDSClusterSnapshot)<-[:RESOURCE]-(:AWSAccount{id: $AWS_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:AWSOrganization{id: $ORGANIZATION_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID}) WHERE snapshot.exposed_internet IS NOT NULL WITH snapshot LIMIT $LIMIT_SIZE REMOVE snapshot.exposed_internet, snapshot.exposed_internet_type, snapshot.publicContext return COUNT(*) as TotalCompleted

statements.__comment: A cluster snapshot whose restore attribute holds 'all' can be copied or restored by any AWS account, like a DB snapshot.
statements.query: MATCH (snapshot:RDSClusterSnapshot)<-[:RESOURCE]-(:AWSAccount{id: $AWS_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:AWSOrganization{id: $ORGANIZATION_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID}) WHERE 'all' IN snapshot.restore_attribute_values WITH snapshot OPTIONAL MATCH (cluster:RDSCluster|NeptuneCluster)-[:IS_SNAPSHOT_SOURCE]->(snapshot) WITH snapshot, head(collect(cluster)) AS cluster SET snapshot.exposed_internet = true, snapshot.exposed_internet_type = ['restore_all_attrib'], snapshot.publicContext = apoc.convert.toJson([{resource: snapshot.id, resourceType: 'aws-database-rds-cluster-snapshot', context: [{snapshotId: snapshot.id, snapshotArn: snapshot.arn, sourceClusterId: cluster.id, sourceEngine: snapshot.engine, restoreAttribute: snapshot.restore_attribute_values, exposureTypes: ['restore_all_attrib'], encrypted: coalesce(snapshot.storage_encrypted, false)}]}])
